title: Express tour of...
text: Express tour of Barcelona and the bus tour is the best solution to be able to discover this magnificent city😍 welcoming staff on board, nothing to complain about
author: emeline_t

title: Very positive experience
text:
Very positive experience with the Hop-On Hop-Off bus from Julia Travel. The service is
well organized, the buses are punctual, and the frequency is excellent, ideal for moving
between the main attractions without stress. The route is complete and allows you to
see all of Barcelona in a comfortable and scenic way.

Clear and useful audio guide, perfect for getting oriented and learning more about the city.
Friendly and helpful staff, always ready to assist and provide directions
on stops and travel times.

Great solution for those who want to visit Barcelona in a simple, relaxed way
without was
author: Aniello D

title: Wonderful journey with Viator Love to do more in future
text:
We took red route & green route tours 
Visit to Acquarium in Port Vell 
Ride on hop on & hop off green line was excellent .
author: Meenu_M

title: Recommended! Well organized and nice staff
text:
Incredibly nice experience. Cozy staff who took a picture of us when we got in, which we could later pay for if we wanted to take care of it. 
Very exciting to see, well arranged for those with any wheelchair needs and plenty of space if there is a lot of people present. 
Incredibly fun and nice experience
author: Anastasia W

title: This was a great tour!
text: This was a great city to tour.  So much to see and do.  The architecture was amazing.  The aquarium is really nice for families.
author: Donna_O

title: Saves walking
text: Being able to see the beautiful  city of Barcelona by bus and the Hop Off Hop On allows you to do this.
author: Marlene_M

title: Perfect way to see the City
text: Booked 48 hours Barcelona city tour with aquarium. It was a great way to see the city and also used it as a way to move around without  needing taxis. The only issue we had was we booked our hotel at the Sant station stop which we didn’t know until we got to the stop that ie was closed and it took us a lot of time going round in circles to find the next stop.
author: Raheela_A

title: Enjoyable time
text: Had a great time travelled both routes to completion. The Aquarium was great there is a little walk from the stop but we expected this.
author: Christy_M

title: Nice experience!
text: Fun experience, especially in the glass tunnel where the sharks and all kinds of fish swim over and next to you!
author: Z6420ZXnicolev

title: Good way to see the city
text: Hop on hop off was convenient way to see the whole city. Liked that we could switch from orange line to green line as needed. Aquarium was beautiful! Very hot and crowded in the summer and no air conditioning working on some buses.
author: Scott_G
